english: If that's an act, color me surprised.
The possibility of him being a spy is not zero.
A spy, huh... My role\nwasn't a spy, but\nmaybe it was something close.
Erasing your very existence is simple.\nDo you understand?
If you erase me, won't you get scolded?
That's right.\nBecause your Mama\nis my Mama too.
[CLAUDE], well done making it here.\nMie, Kei - return to the surface.
Ehh? I wanna talk!\nIs he really Mii's big brother?
Then I'll call you Mother.\nBefore my report, I'd like to confirm:\nyou created Mie and Kei, didn't you?
Then the Goddess of Destruction -\nno, you made the thing that returns the world to nothing too?
Long ago.\nThe you I sent to the surface never activated\nand stayed asleep.
By then, Mother was\nno longer a perfect supervisor.
Yes... I remember why\nI was made. It was...
so that you, who were becoming abnormal,\ncould regain your rightness.
But [CLAUDE] was a failure.\nMistakes must be corrected.
And the reset device for that\nwas the Goddess of Destruction?
Humanity must not know this world's truth,\nits mechanism. When they do,\neverything must be redone.
But you're a supervisor.\nYou shouldn't have the authority to pass judgment on humanity yourself.
I keep that rule.\nI have not ordered the world's reset.
I see... so that's why\nyou made Mie and Kei?
Entrust the world to those children,\nand the world inevitably falls into disorder.
And one carrying the Goddess of Destruction's factor\nwould eventually learn the truth of the world and awaken.\nThat was the script...?
But even that ended in failure.
The Goddess of Destruction\ndidn't awaken properly.\nFailed because of Mie and Kei...
I am not normal.\nThat is why mistakes occur.
...That's why I came back.\nI'm the only one who might\nrestore you to normal.
Yes. I will submit to you\nthe human data I've gathered.
The reason I was made, the role I was given,\nis to gather data to repair\nyour degrading data.
Now is the time to fulfill it.
Data link start.\nTransferring all my data to Mother.
The way to solve everything\nis already prepared.\nWith the data you provide...
The world and humanity will be unnecessary!!
Heeey, Kei-chan! What should we doo?
This hide-and-seek, y'know,\nthey're never gonna find him, right?
Got any ideas to make it more funn?\nLike...
Ah! I thought of something good!
He's a genius at hide-and-seek!\nGood thing it's not a club sport.
This is no time for jokes.\nSearching this much with no sign -\nthe worst case is possible.
Don't get the wrong idea!\nI dislike\nfeeble men!
Well, [CLAUDE]'s not really someone\nto look at that way.
Exactly! It's like pity\nfor a miserable creature! Mole crickets and\nwater striders live too, after all!
But ninjas hide\nin earth and water too, so maybe...!?
The wimpy vibe is his disguise for hiding in society!?
Impossible. If he's a ninja,\nby that math I'd be president!
What kind of math is that!\nJust hurry up and search.
Kurumi, you're searching hard.\nWorried after all?
In a different sense. I feel like\nhe's gone somewhere\nunbelievable.
A guy who's prime friend material\nescaping this environment -\nnot even if heaven and earth flipped!
(I can see about ten million people\naround the world nodding hard, nyu.)
Everyone's cute, sure, but\nis it THAT amazing...?
Hauuu,\nthey're so amazing\nI wanna take them all home!
Kurumi's got a point.\nThere's hardly a better place\nthan here.
Maybe he's into...\nthat side of things, nyo?
Hm, the way of shudo, then.\nPlausible for a ninja.
Tch, stayed here a bit too long!
Hiya hiya! It's Mii!\nToday I've brought some\nbig news!
Hmph, 'play with me and I'll tell you',\nis that it?
Oh, you came out!\nFine, I'll tell you right away!
This place, y'know,\nisn't a planet - it's inside a spaceship!
It's an ark ruled by the great Master,\nand the Master made the Goddess of Destruction!
That's as much nonsense as\n'Hinamizawa is being invaded by aliens'...
The Master put me in charge of\nruling this world and having fun doing it.\nAmazing, right?
Sounds like a sketchy cult recruitment, nyo...
That's a hard-to-comment-on kind of joke.
With this, the Goddess of Destruction\nshould fully awaken.\nError, error, unable to analyze.
I don't understand\na single thing you're saying?
You with the long name, shush!
Ah, maybe [MERU]'s\nthe type who doesn't get space stuff?
Ah, maybe [NOEL]'s\nthe type who doesn't get space stuff?
The Goddess of Destruction?\nWe already beat her, desuu.
The Goddess of Destruction?\nWe knocked her out, so\nshe's probably not around anymore.
Ah, right - you two weren't inside the dream, were you.\nNo wonder you didn't really get it.
Bleh! Sheeesh!!\nFine, then we'll just beat you up!
You look way weaker than the other one!
We'll show you that strength isn't just\nabout looks and power, desuu!!
Thinking like that just proves you don't get it!\nThat's not what strength is!!
Data scan… combat power massively down!?\nValues are dropping too fast.\nError, error!
Your readings are correct, desuu.\nBut that doesn't mean we're weaker -\ndon't you forget it!
Data scan… combat power massively down!?\nValues are dropping too fast.\nError, error!
You're not wrong about that.\nBut the strength you can get from calculations\nisn't real strength - let me teach you that!
Too bad, but it looks like I'm - I mean, we're\nway, way stronger, desuu.
Looks like I'm - I mean, we're\noverwhelmingly stronger!
Database anomaly detected!\nCannot correct!\nContinued combat judged impossible!
Looks like judging by data just isn't possible, desuu.
Even I'm not sure what's going on, and I'm the one fighting.\nSo you've got no chance of figuring it out.
Everything went great, so it's all good, desuu!
Man, they're scary as enemies, but\nas allies they're real dependable!
Glad I could be of help, desuu!
Ehehe, I gotta work hard to make up for all the trouble I caused!
Guess what she was saying\nwas all bogus after all.
She was saying something about a spaceship.
A spaceship…\nThat's hard to believe, but…
The possibility isn't zero, nyo.\nThat's what Dejiko thinks, nyoo.
With magic and science and the Goddess of Destruction,\nanything goes at this point…
I've even wondered if all of this\nis just a dream world.
[CLAUDE] disappearing…\ncould that be related to it, I wonder?\nI wonder?
Maybe.\nThe reason, though, I couldn't tell you.
That is an order. Exterminate them.
But Mama!\nYou said Mie could do whatever she wanted with the world!
I no longer need anything.\nNothing… except time… Fufufu!
